quote.text: Death hangs over thee. While thou livest, while it is in thy power, be good.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the inevitability of life's finite nature by modeling kindness and goodness; let your actions resonate with the virtues you wish to nurture in your children.
    • Recognize that every moment with your family is a precious opportunity to instill moral values, shaping not only your own character but also that of the next generation.
  • Leadership
    • Accept that the weight of mortality underscores the urgency of making decisions that are not merely expedient, but righteous and just.
    • Lead by example with integrity; let the awareness of life's fleeting nature inform a commitment to serve others and create a meaningful legacy.
  • Product Management
    • In a field driven by deadlines and innovation, remember that ethical decision-making and a focus on quality reflect the deeper good that transcends immediate profits.
    • Let the awareness of life's impermanence inspire you to prioritize work that adds value and positively impacts users, ensuring each decision contributes to a product that stands the test of time.
